_comment: Example config for run_pipeline.py on tokenizer sample v0. Paths are relative to the repository root. clean, overlap and dedup are TSAI jobs: 'adopt' points at the folders TSAI returned. Switch a stage to 'run' with a 'command' to run it here instead.

f2._workers: parallel run_f2.py processes, one per pack folder; each needs about 1.1 GB of memory

apply._link: hard-link untouched parts instead of copying them (same file system)

ledger._raw: optional: the raw parts the cleaner read (<raw>/<split>/<pack>/part-*.parquet). Set "raw" for mode B (keep / fix / drop per document); without it the ledger is mode C (clean_action unknown)
